snippet.title: Otwocki Łomot - Trailer (comic-book beat 'em up, free demo out now)
snippet.description:
Otwocki Łomot is a comic-book beat 'em up set in a real Polish town. Someone took Ciapek, the dog. Rudy wants him back.

Android (Google Play) - out now, free demo: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=eu.sharkystudio.otwockilomot

PC demo (browser + Windows): https://websharky.itch.io/otwocki-lomot
Full game on PC: https://websharky.itch.io/otwocki-lomot/purchase

Made by Sharky Studio, one independent developer from Poland.
